title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Glassdoor Canada pools listings that also surface via Indeed and other aggregators, alongside a smaller set of titles unique to this site — the score measures technical/domain fit only, not pay or location.
latest_update: Latest update: September 22, 2026 — all six mandatory Canada queries completed, eight results per query reviewed before dedup. Five new postings validated: Exaion's Private Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (Montreal hybrid, score 4), Export Development Canada's Cybersecurity Engineer (Ottawa/Toronto/Montreal, score 3), and three exclusions (InfoTrack Toronto — ineligible geography; Logistec and Haber — domain mismatch). Zero postings cleared the auto-file threshold (score ≥5) today.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer - Dev Ops
rows.gap: Ineligible geography: the full posting requires two days each week in the London office, outside Marc's reachable hybrid cities; the technical scope also requires deep production Kubernetes and MLOps/LLM infrastructure.

rows.title: Site Reliability Engineer
rows.gap: AWS multi-account + EKS/Kubernetes 'at scale' ownership is deeper than Marc's provisioning-side K8s depth (CKA in progress, not complete); otherwise strong overlap — incident command, Terraform/Ansible IaC, Datadog observability, and explicit AI-assisted-engineering tooling (Amazon Kiro) matching Marc's own Énergir practice

rows.title: Observability / DevOps Advisor
rows.gap: Salary range straddles the $120k Montréal on-site/hybrid floor — most of the range sits below it, only the top clears; otherwise a strong fit: Terraform CI/CD, Dynatrace/Elasticsearch observability, insurance-sector regulated environment, and explicit enterprise-AI-tooling emphasis. Bilingual requirement is a Marc asset, not a gap.

rows.title: Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Requires self-hosted Kubernetes cluster administration — a real depth gap (Marc's K8s experience is provisioning/automation-side, not deep node/cluster ops); GCP-or-AWS requirement is flexible, not a hard gate on its own

rows.title: Private Cloud Infrastructure Administrator F/H
rows.gap: Real tooling overlap (Ansible, Linux/CentOS/Debian administration, Kubernetes, Python, Bash, ELK, Prometheus/Grafana), but the scope reads as Level 2 infrastructure support and maintenance — daily incident response, documentation upkeep, escalating to tier-3 — not senior platform ownership or architecture. No salary stated to confirm it clears the $120k Montréal hybrid floor. A different Exaion req ("Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Delivery Lead") was already Skipped 2026-09-19 for an HPC/GPU gap — this is a separate, more junior-leaning role at the same employer.

rows.title: Senior Platform & AI Systems Engineer
rows.location: Victoria, BC — hybrid, onsite as needed
rows.gap: Location hard-gate — Victoria BC is far outside Marc's reachable on-site/hybrid range (Ottawa/Kingston/Brockville/Cornwall/Montréal); otherwise this would have scored 8+ (AWS/Azure/Terraform/K8s, explicit daily use of Claude Code/OpenAI Codex, SRE ownership, no people-management requirement)

rows.title: Verification and Validation Developer – Infrastructure & Automation
rows.gap: Domain mismatch — center of gravity is RF/wireless/embedded test-lab automation (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, LTE/5G) rather than cloud/platform engineering; also requires eligibility for Canadian Security Clearance

rows.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - 405 EN
rows.location: Ottawa, ON (or Toronto/Montréal hub) — hybrid, 2 days/week now, moving to 3 days/week by Sept 2026 (phased)
rows.salary: CAD $96,557–$128,742/year (employer stated, Cyber Security Specialist 18) + performance incentive
rows.gap: Domain mismatch — this is a cybersecurity engineering generalist role (application/cloud/identity/network security breadth, embedding with delivery teams on DevSecOps practices), requiring 7+ years of dedicated cybersecurity engineering experience, not infrastructure/platform ownership. Marc's adjacent security work (CVE/EoL tracking and SSL/TLS scoring at Tink, Splunk config-drift alerting at Desjardins) is real but doesn't reach a specialist security-engineer bar. Salary midpoint clears the $100k Ottawa hybrid floor; Azure-preferred is a plus.

rows.title: Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Specialist
rows.location: Ottawa, ON — hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.gap: Confirmed duplicate of the Morson Talent posting already filed and Rejected via Indeed on 2026-09-15 (score 2) — same title, same rate range, same recruiter family. Also requires Secret/CGP/Trade clearance (unconfirmed) and the rate is below target for a 3-days/week on-site cadence.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: Hard gate — AWS Serverless/Containers implementation experience is mandatory and explicitly states 'support or DevOps experience is NOT relevant'; the deliverable is AWS-native architecture ownership (Lambda, ECS Fargate, CDK/CloudFormation) at exactly the scale profile.md's hard-gate rule excludes

rows.title: DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Hard gate — posting states production experience with both GCP and AWS is 'non-negotiable'

rows.title: Conseiller DevOps / DevSecOps sénior
rows.gap: Hard gate — requires hands-on professional experience with Google Cloud Platform as the primary environment (GCP landing zones, GCP certifications as an asset); Marc has zero GCP exposure. Would otherwise have been an excellent match on salary and Montréal hybrid location.

rows.title: Senior DevOps Specialist (SaaS Healthcare)
rows.gap: Hard gate — posting explicitly requires candidates to reside in the province of Quebec; Marc is based in Smiths Falls, ON. Same recurring employer-level residency gate seen on an earlier MEDFAR posting via Indeed.

rows.title: Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Domain mismatch — deep distributed-systems backend engineering (Go, Kafka, ClickHouse, event-driven architecture at billions-of-events scale) is the actual job, not infrastructure/DevOps

rows.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
rows.location: Calgary, AB — onsite/hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.gap: Location hard-gate (Calgary is outside the reachable range) compounded by an AWS-native architecture-ownership hard gate — CloudFormation StackSets, multi-account AWS Organizations, and IAM/networking ownership are the actual deliverables

rows.title: Directeur.rice principal, développement de logiciel (Software Development)
rows.gap: Out of scope — director-level software development leadership (people management of a dev org), not infrastructure/platform/SRE, and the Glassdoor-estimated range sits below the $120k Montréal FTE floor even at the top end
rows.status: Out of scope — director-level software dev leadership

rows.status: Skipped — pulp & paper process engineering, not IT

rows.gap: Ineligible geography — Toronto is outside Marc's reachable on-site/hybrid range (Ottawa/Kingston/Brockville/Cornwall/Montréal); appeared independently across three separate keyword queries (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer), suggesting a strong keyword match that the location gate still excludes

could_not_validate.text: Olive Systems "Forward Deployed Engineer — One Process, Multiple Opportunities" (Remote) is not an actual job requisition — it's a staffing/matching funnel ("MakeHire") for Forward Deployed Engineer roles at US companies, with no specific employer, compensation, or Canada eligibility stated. Read in full; could not be scored as a posting.

notes_sections.heading: September 22 query audit
items: DevOps Engineer: 110 rendered (N=22); first 8 reviewed; Complete. Candidates: CARFAX (dup), LYNKED Inc. (London, unreachable, $58-69K), LMI Technologies (Burnaby, unreachable), BMO Associate DevOps Engineer (Toronto, unreachable), Wissen Infotech (dup), Moneris Manager SRE/DevOps (Toronto, unreachable + people-management), InfoTrack Canada (Toronto, unreachable — added as Ineligible row), Octasic (dup). 0 new eligible.

Platform Engineer: 1,321 rendered (N=24); first 8 reviewed; Complete — reconfirmed structurally noisy (Tactable Tech Lead, Soneil Spark Senior SWE, CATSA Data Engineer and similar non-DevOps titles dominate). 0 new eligible.

Site Reliability Engineer: 297 rendered (N=32); first 8 reviewed; Complete — reconfirmed noise-dominated (VIA Rail structural/electrical reliability, Capgemini air-systems, X-Group electrical engineer). 0 new eligible.

Cloud Engineer: N=20 truncated to "Cloud enginee" and returned 0 results; retried at N=21 → 728 rendered, clean phrase match. First 8 reviewed; Complete. New candidate: Exaion's "Private Cloud Infrastructure Administrator F/H" (Montreal hybrid, score 4). Rest were duplicates (Exaion Delivery Lead already Skipped 2026-09-19, CARFAX) or unreachable (FinneyTaylor/Edmonton, Thales/Vancouver, Tactable/Toronto, LYNKED/London, Soneil Spark/Brampton).

DevSecOps Engineer: 23 rendered (N=25); first 8 reviewed; Complete, clean phrase match as in prior runs. New candidates: Export Development Canada's "Cybersecurity Engineer - 405 EN" (Ottawa/Toronto/Montreal, score 3, domain mismatch) and Logistec's director-level software-dev role (Montreal, score 2, out of scope). BMO's two Toronto postings (Principal Cloud Security Engineer, Principal Engineer AI) are unreachable and not added as rows given no other decision-relevant detail.

Forward Deployed Engineer: 23 rendered (N=32); first 8 reviewed; Complete — reconfirmed dominated by AI/GenAI deployment and unrelated-domain "forward deployed" titles. New candidates: Haber's pulp-and-paper process-engineering role (Montreal, score 0, total domain mismatch despite the matching title) and Olive Systems' staffing funnel (not a real posting, logged under Could Not Validate). Turnifai (AI enablement for private equity, Toronto) and PocketHealth (pre-sales Solutions Engineer, GTA-office-twice-weekly) were opened and are both out of scope on domain and geography — not added as rows.
The six passes produced 48 result appearances before dedup. No CAPTCHA, sign-in, saved-job, alert, or application action occurred.

notes_sections.heading: Indeed/Glassdoor overlap
items: No newly confirmed cross-board duplicates today beyond the standing Morson Group/Morson Talent match already on record.

InfoTrack Canada's Toronto posting recurred across three separate keyword queries this run (DevOps, Platform, DevSecOps) — a genuinely strong keyword match, excluded purely on the Toronto location hard-gate.

notes_sections.heading: Keyword reliability this run
items: "DevOps Engineer" (N=22, 110 results) and "DevSecOps Engineer" (N=25, 23 results) both phrase-matched cleanly again.
"Cloud Engineer" needed a retry — N=20 truncated the query text and returned 0 results; N=21 gave a clean 728-result match. Worth updating the default N guess for this keyword to 21.
"Platform Engineer" and "Site Reliability Engineer" reconfirmed structurally unusable regardless of N, consistent with every prior run — not worth retrying with different N values.

"Forward Deployed Engineer" phrase-matched correctly (23 results) but the keyword itself is now dominated by AI/GenAI deployment roles and unrelated "forward deployed" job titles in other industries (process engineering, real estate/OT networking) — a domain drift away from infra/platform DevOps, same pattern noted in the 2026-09-08 run.

method: All six mandatory Canada keyword queries were executed independently in a rendered browser and the first eight results of each were captured before deduplication (48 appearances). Platform and SRE queries remain highly noisy but were still audited in full. Five new postings were validated and scored; zero cleared the score ≥5 auto-file threshold. Existing validated rows and pipeline statuses (Applied: Tecsys, Intact) were preserved exactly, including prior score/family/gap text.
